name: Costel Moraru
title: Amateur astrophotographer
bio: Costel Moraru is a software and technology enthusiast based in Bayern, Germany, a father of two, and an amateur astrophotographer fascinated by the wonders of the night sky. Driven by a lifelong dream of space exploration and space travel, he explores the universe through his telescopes, capturing the beauty and mystery of celestial objects.
philosophy: I believe the universe is full of wonders waiting to be discovered. Although space exploration and interstellar travel remain distant dreams, I can explore the cosmos from here, looking through my telescopes at the beauty of the night sky. Through technology, curiosity, and astrophotography, I seek to bring the wonders of the universe a little closer.
